sinopsis.es: Dos excombatientes de las FARC luchan por mantener viva su relación y construir una familia durante su tránsito a la vida civil. A lo largo de cinco años, el documental acompaña su proceso de reintegración mientras enfrentan los desafíos personales y sociales que deja el conflicto armado colombiano.
sinopsis.en: Two young former FARC guerrillas struggle to keep their love alive and start a family during the transition from war to peace. We follow them over five years as they reintegrate into civilian life, build a home, and welcome their first child. Having lived through the conflict, they are determined never to return to war, but Colombia's peace process is deeply polarized, and their future remains uncertain.
